mapper.select: select lt.leave_type_id, lt.leave_type_code, lt.leave_type_name, lt.is_deduct, lt.is_active from leave_request lr join leave_type lt on lt.leave_type_id = lr.leave_type_id where lr.emp_id = #{empId} and lr.status = 'APPROVED' and #{date} between lr.start_date and lr.end_date order by lt.leave_type_id
